sections.title: Software development for insurance brokers
sections.subtitle: We develop custom software solutions to help you simplify processes, connect platforms, and respond to the real needs of your business.
sections.buttonText: Learn how we can help you

sections.title: Do you identify with any of these challenges?

services.title: How many platforms do you need to open to quote a policy?
services.description: Between insurers, multi-quoters, CRM and other tools, a single quote may require checking different systems and moving information from one to another. This makes the process slower and increases manual work.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Today it is possible to integrate multi-quoters, insurer portals and other platforms to streamline the quoting process.

services.title: Do renewals still depend on manual follow-up?
services.description: When tracking expirations, reminders and follow-ups depends on spreadsheets or manual tasks, keeping pace as your portfolio grows becomes increasingly complex.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Automatic alerts, CRMs and follow-up workflows help maintain better control over renewals.

services.title: Is tracking a claim still a manual process?
services.description: Calls, emails and consultations between the client and the insurer make it difficult to know the status of each case and provide timely responses.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Integrating claims tracking makes traceability easier and allows you to respond more quickly to clients.

services.title: Is your customer information distributed across different platforms?
services.description: Commercial, administrative and insurer data is often spread across different systems. This makes it difficult to have a complete view of each client and make decisions with up-to-date information.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Centralizing customer information facilitates commercial follow-up and faster decision-making.

sections.title: What can we develop for your business?
sections.description: Each insurance broker faces different challenges. That's why we develop custom technology solutions that adapt to the way your business operates.
